# Bard Subclass (`features:bard-subclass`)
**Class:** [Bard](../classes/bard.md) | **Level:** [Bard 3](../levels/bard-3.md)

You gain a Bard subclass of your choice. The The College of Lore subclass is detailed after this class's description. A subclass is a specialization that grants you features at certain Bard levels. For the rest of your career, you gain each of your subclass's features that are of your Bard level or lower.
